fields.name: poolCreatorAuthority
docs: Only pool_creator_authority can use the current config to initialize new pool. When it's Pubkey::default, it's a public config.

fields.name: escrowVault
docs: Vault address, store the lock user lock

fields.name: lpPerToken
docs: Lp per token, virtual price of lp token

fields.name: aFee
docs: Total a fee claimed so far

fields.name: bFee
docs: Total b fee claimed so far

fields.name: lpMint
docs: LP token mint of the pool

fields.name: tokenAmint
docs: Token A mint of the pool. Eg: USDT

fields.name: tokenBmint
docs: Token B mint of the pool. Eg: USDC

fields.name: aVault
docs: Vault account for token A. Token A of the pool will be deposit / withdraw from this vault account.

fields.name: bVault
docs: Vault account for token B. Token B of the pool will be deposit / withdraw from this vault account.

fields.name: aVaultLp
docs: LP token account of vault A. Used to receive/burn the vault LP upon deposit/withdraw from the vault.

fields.name: bVaultLp
docs: LP token account of vault B. Used to receive/burn the vault LP upon deposit/withdraw from the vault.

fields.name: aVaultLpBump
docs: "A" vault lp bump. Used to create signer seeds.

fields.name: enabled
docs: Flag to determine whether the pool is enabled, or disabled.

fields.name: protocolTokenAfee
docs: Protocol fee token account for token A. Used to receive trading fee.

fields.name: protocolTokenBfee
docs: Protocol fee token account for token B. Used to receive trading fee.

fields.name: stake
docs: Stake pubkey of SPL stake pool

fields.name: curveType
docs: The type of the swap curve supported by the pool.

fields.name: mintAuthority
docs: Optional authority used to mint new tokens. The mint authority may only
be provided during mint creation. If no mint authority is present
then the mint has a fixed supply and no further tokens may be minted.

fields.name: decimals
docs: Number of base 10 digits to the right of the decimal place.

fields.name: isInitialized
docs: Is `true` if this structure has been initialized.

fields.name: freezeAuthority
docs: Optional authority to freeze token accounts.

display.interpolatedIntent: ${accounts.admin} creates permissioned pool ${accounts.pool} of ${accounts.tokenAmint} and ${accounts.tokenBmint}

${accounts.payer} creates pool ${accounts.pool} of ${accounts.tokenAmint} and ${accounts.tokenBmint}, depositing ${data.tokenAamount} of ${accounts.tokenAmint} from ${accounts.payerTokenA} and ${data.tokenBamount} of ${accounts.tokenBmint} from ${accounts.payerTokenB}

instructions.name: initializePermissionlessPoolWithFeeTier
docs: Initialize a new permissionless pool with customized fee tier

display.intent: Create a pool with a fee tier
display.interpolatedIntent: ${accounts.payer} creates pool ${accounts.pool} of ${accounts.tokenAmint} and ${accounts.tokenBmint} with a trading fee of ${data.tradeFeeBps}, depositing ${data.tokenAamount} of ${accounts.tokenAmint} from ${accounts.payerTokenA} and ${data.tokenBamount} of ${accounts.tokenBmint} from ${accounts.payerTokenB}

instructions.name: enableOrDisablePool
docs: Enable or disable a pool. A disabled pool allow only remove balanced liquidity operation.

display.interpolatedIntent: ${accounts.admin} sets whether pool ${accounts.pool} is enabled to ${data.enable}

instructions.name: swap
docs: Swap token A to B, or vice versa. An amount of trading fee will be charged for liquidity provider, and the admin of the pool.

display.interpolatedIntent: ${accounts.user} swaps ${data.inAmount} from ${accounts.userSourceToken} for at least ${data.minimumOutAmount} into ${accounts.userDestinationToken}, in pool ${accounts.pool}

docs: For a stable pool of a staking token, the account the pool reads that token's price from (the Marinade state, the Lido state or the SPL stake pool); then, when the swap has a referrer, the referrer's token account, which receives part of the protocol fee.

instructions.name: removeLiquiditySingleSide
docs: Withdraw only single token from the pool. Only supported by pool with stable swap curve.

display.interpolatedIntent: ${accounts.user} burns ${data.poolTokenAmount} of LP token ${accounts.lpMint} from ${accounts.userPoolLp} to remove liquidity from pool ${accounts.pool} as one token, for at least ${data.minimumOutAmount} into ${accounts.userDestinationToken}

docs: For a stable pool of a staking token, the account the pool reads that token's price from (the Marinade state, the Lido state or the SPL stake pool).

instructions.name: addImbalanceLiquidity
docs: Deposit tokens to the pool in an imbalance ratio. Only supported by pool with stable swap curve.

display.interpolatedIntent: ${accounts.user} adds ${data.tokenAamount} from ${accounts.userAtoken} and ${data.tokenBamount} from ${accounts.userBtoken} to pool ${accounts.pool}, for at least ${data.minimumPoolTokenAmount} of LP token ${accounts.lpMint}

docs: For a stable pool of a staking token, the account the pool reads that token's price from (the Marinade state, the Lido state or the SPL stake pool).

instructions.name: removeBalanceLiquidity
docs: Withdraw tokens from the pool in a balanced ratio. User will still able to withdraw from pool even the pool is disabled. This allow user to exit their liquidity when there's some unforeseen event happen.

display.interpolatedIntent: ${accounts.user} burns ${data.poolTokenAmount} of LP token ${accounts.lpMint} from ${accounts.userPoolLp} to remove liquidity from pool ${accounts.pool}, for at least ${data.minimumAtokenOut} into ${accounts.userAtoken} and ${data.minimumBtokenOut} into ${accounts.userBtoken}

docs: For a stable pool of a staking token, the account the pool reads that token's price from (the Marinade state, the Lido state or the SPL stake pool).

instructions.name: addBalanceLiquidity
docs: Deposit tokens to the pool in a balanced ratio.

display.interpolatedIntent: ${accounts.user} adds liquidity to pool ${accounts.pool} for ${data.poolTokenAmount} of LP token ${accounts.lpMint}, paying at most ${data.maximumTokenAamount} from ${accounts.userAtoken} and ${data.maximumTokenBamount} from ${accounts.userBtoken}

docs: For a stable pool of a staking token, the account the pool reads that token's price from (the Marinade state, the Lido state or the SPL stake pool).

instructions.name: setPoolFees
docs: Update trading fee charged for liquidity provider, and admin.

display.interpolatedIntent: ${accounts.feeOperator} sets the trading, protocol and partner fees of pool ${accounts.pool}

instructions.name: overrideCurveParam
docs: Update swap curve parameters. This function do not allow update of curve type. For example: stable swap curve to constant product curve. Only supported by pool with stable swap curve.
Only amp is allowed to be override. The other attributes of stable swap curve will be ignored.

display.interpolatedIntent: ${accounts.admin} changes the curve parameters of pool ${accounts.pool}

instructions.name: getPoolInfo
docs: Get the general information of the pool.

display.interpolatedIntent: Reports the information of pool ${accounts.pool}

instructions.name: bootstrapLiquidity
docs: Bootstrap the pool when liquidity is depleted.

display.interpolatedIntent: ${accounts.user} adds ${data.tokenAamount} from ${accounts.userAtoken} and ${data.tokenBamount} from ${accounts.userBtoken} to pool ${accounts.pool}, whose liquidity is depleted

docs: For a stable pool of a staking token, the account the pool reads that token's price from (the Marinade state, the Lido state or the SPL stake pool).

instructions.name: createMintMetadata
docs: Create mint metadata account for old pools

display.interpolatedIntent: ${accounts.payer} creates the metadata of LP token ${accounts.lpMint} of pool ${accounts.pool}
${accounts.payer} creates lock escrow ${accounts.lockEscrow} for ${accounts.owner} in pool ${accounts.pool}
${accounts.owner} locks at most ${data.maxAmount} of LP token ${accounts.lpMint} from ${accounts.sourceTokens} in lock escrow ${accounts.lockEscrow} of pool ${accounts.pool}

${accounts.owner} claims the fees of the liquidity locked in lock escrow ${accounts.lockEscrow} of pool ${accounts.pool}, up to ${data.maxAmount} of LP token ${accounts.lpMint}, paid to ${accounts.userAtoken} and ${accounts.userBtoken}
${accounts.admin} creates config ${accounts.config}
${accounts.admin} closes config ${accounts.config}, with the rent going to ${accounts.rentReceiver}

display.interpolatedIntent: ${accounts.payer} creates pool ${accounts.pool} of ${accounts.tokenAmint} and ${accounts.tokenBmint} under config ${accounts.config}, depositing ${data.tokenAamount} of ${accounts.tokenAmint} from ${accounts.payerTokenA} and ${data.tokenBamount} of ${accounts.tokenBmint} from ${accounts.payerTokenB}

display.intent: Create a pool under a config
display.interpolatedIntent: ${accounts.payer} creates pool ${accounts.pool} of ${accounts.tokenAmint} and ${accounts.tokenBmint} under config ${accounts.config}, depositing ${data.tokenAamount} of ${accounts.tokenAmint} from ${accounts.payerTokenA} and ${data.tokenBamount} of ${accounts.tokenBmint} from ${accounts.payerTokenB}

instructions.name: initializeCustomizablePermissionlessConstantProductPool
docs: Initialize permissionless pool with customizable params

display.interpolatedIntent: ${accounts.payer} creates pool ${accounts.pool} of ${accounts.tokenAmint} and ${accounts.tokenBmint} with its own fee settings, depositing ${data.tokenAamount} of ${accounts.tokenAmint} from ${accounts.payerTokenA} and ${data.tokenBamount} of ${accounts.tokenBmint} from ${accounts.payerTokenB}

display.label: New Activation Point (Slot or Unix Time)

display.interpolatedIntent: ${accounts.admin} sets the activation point of pool ${accounts.pool} to ${data.newActivationPoint}
${accounts.admin} makes ${data.whitelistedVault} the whitelisted vault of pool ${accounts.pool}
${accounts.partnerAuthority} claims the partner fees of pool ${accounts.pool}, at most ${data.maxAmountA} into ${accounts.partnerTokenA} and ${data.maxAmountB} into ${accounts.partnerTokenB}

definedTypes.name: tokenMultiplier
docs: Multiplier for the pool token. Used to normalized token with different decimal into the same precision.

fields.name: tokenAmultiplier
docs: Multiplier for token A of the pool.

fields.name: tokenBmultiplier
docs: Multiplier for token B of the pool.

fields.name: precisionFactor
docs: Record the highest token decimal in the pool. For example, Token A is 6 decimal, token B is 9 decimal. This will save value of 9.

fields.name: tradeFeeNumerator
docs: Trade fees are extra token amounts that are held inside the token
accounts during a trade, making the value of liquidity tokens rise.

fields.name: protocolTradeFeeNumerator
docs: Protocol trading fees are extra token amounts that are held inside the token
accounts during a trade, with the equivalent in pool tokens minted to

fields.name: baseVirtualPrice
docs: The virtual price of staking / interest bearing token

fields.name: baseCacheUpdated
docs: The last time base_virtual_price is updated

fields.name: hasAlphaVault
docs: Whether the pool support alpha vault

fields.name: activationPoint
docs: Activation point, can be slot or timestamp

fields.name: whitelistedVault
docs: Whitelisted vault to be able to buy pool before activation_point

fields.name: poolCreator
docs: Need to store pool creator in lauch pool, so they can modify liquidity before activation_point

fields.name: activationType
docs: Activation type, 0 means by slot, 1 means by timestamp
